sentences.show: A sailor saw the New World first. Columbus took his reward.
It happened on this day in 1492.
Columbus had sailed west with three ships, looking for a shortcut to Asia.
After five weeks of open ocean, his sailors wanted to go home.
The king and queen had promised a pension for life to whoever saw land first.
At 2 in the morning, a lookout on the Pinta shouted: "Land! Land!"
His name was Rodrigo de Triana.
But Columbus said he had seen a light 4 hours earlier, "like a little wax candle".
The island was Guanahani. He named it San Salvador.
He was sure he had reached Asia, and called its people "Indians".
For them, it was the start of a conquest.
And the year after Columbus died, the New World was named after another man.
Also on this day: the first woman parachuted from a balloon, and Khrushchev banged his shoe at the UN.
